title: Venezuelan-Style Fried Plantain Empanadas
description: A crispy, savory empanada filled with sweet plantains, a classic Venezuelan street food. Serve as a snack or side dish.
instructions: Peel the plantains and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
Heat about 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Mix the plantain pieces with a pinch of salt and fry until golden brown (about 3-4 minutes).
While the plantains are frying, preheat a baking sheet in the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or glass.
Place a few pieces of fried plantain in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the empanadas on the preheated baking sheet and brush with a little vegetable oil.
Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
